description: Check an x402 route BEFORE you pay it. GET /v1/prepay?url=<the route> makes ONE unpaid GET with no payment header and no credential, and returns one row: the measured HTTP status, the parsed x402 v2 challenge (scheme / network / asset / amount / payTo), whether that challenge is schema-valid exact-on-Base, and whether its payTo and price agree with the seller's own card (pass `card` to read that card with one more unpaid GET). No payment is made, no credential is sent, no redirect is followed, and a transport failure on our side is reported as unknown rather than as a fact about the seller. Use it to gate a payment decision on measured terms instead of on a seller's prose.

card.description: optional: absolute https URL of the seller's own card/listing page, read with one more unpaid GET to compare the wallet and the price it advertises (agreement is true|false|unknown, and unknown is null, never false)

url.description: absolute https URL of the route you are about to pay

name: prepay_check
